def factor_cycle_skewness_clip(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    skew = ret.rolling(120, min_periods=60).skew()
    factor = skew.clip(lower=-2.0, upper=2.0)
    df_copy["factor_cycle_skewness_clip"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_cycle_skewness_clip"]
